prompt: A pendulum completes one full swing every $0.25\text{ s}$. What is its frequency?
teacher_notes: Reinforce that period is measured in seconds per cycle and frequency in cycles per second.
explanation: Frequency is the reciprocal of the period: $f=\frac{1}{T}=\frac{1}{0.25\text{ s}}=4.0\text{ Hz}$. The pendulum completes four full swings each second. Reporting 0.25 Hz confuses the period with the frequency.
